vocabulary.meaning_en: connected with a king or queen
vocabulary.example: The royal family lives in a palace.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the way you behave towards someone
vocabulary.example: We got excellent treatment at the hotel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the story of a book or film; a secret plan
vocabulary.example: The plot of the film was exciting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to become thicker; to become more complicated
vocabulary.example: Stir the soup until it thickens.
He had a rough day at work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: flat and even; easy, without problems
a move to a higher job
vocabulary.example: She got a promotion last month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of people with the same interest
a plan of activities; a TV or radio show
making you feel shy and silly
vocabulary.example: It was embarrassing to forget his name.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a change that makes something better
vocabulary.example: There's a big improvement in your writing.

fine_lines.title: Take the rough with the smooth vs change for the better
words: take the rough with the smooth
fine_lines.explanation_ar: take the rough with the smooth تعني أن تقبل الجوانب السيئة مع الجيدة في أي وضع. change for the better تعني تغييراً يجعل الأمور أفضل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Take the rough with the smooth' = accept the bad parts together with the good parts. 'A change for the better' = a change that improves things.

examples.word: take the rough with the smooth
examples.sentence: Every job has bad days - you have to take the rough with the smooth.
Moving to a quieter street was a change for the better.

fine_lines.title: Join the club vs it happens to the best of us
words: it happens to the best of us
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما للتعاطف. join the club تعني: أنا أيضاً في الموقف السيئ نفسه. it happens to the best of us تعني: لا تحزن، الجميع يخطئ أحياناً.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both show sympathy. 'Join the club' = I'm in the same bad situation too. 'It happens to the best of us' = don't worry, everyone makes this mistake sometimes.

examples.word: it happens to the best of us
examples.sentence: You forgot your password? It happens to the best of us.

expressions.meaning_en: very special treatment, like an important person
expressions.example: My grandparents gave us the royal treatment when we visited.

expressions.meaning_en: said when a situation becomes more mysterious or complicated
expressions.example: The cake disappeared, and now the biscuits are gone too - the plot thickens!

expressions.meaning_en: a change that makes things better
expressions.example: The new bus timetable is a change for the better.

expressions.phrase: the gift that keeps on giving
expressions.meaning_en: something that continues to give benefits (or sometimes problems) for a long time
expressions.example: That cookery course was the gift that keeps on giving - I cook new dishes every week.

expressions.phrase: take the rough with the smooth
expressions.meaning_en: to accept the bad parts of a situation as well as the good parts
expressions.example: Living abroad is exciting but hard sometimes - you take the rough with the smooth.

expressions.meaning_en: said to someone in the same bad situation as you

expressions.meaning_ar: واكب التغيير / التزم بما هو متوقَّع
expressions.meaning_en: to accept new ideas or do what is expected of you
expressions.example: Everyone uses the new system now - get with the programme!

expressions.phrase: it happens to the best of us
expressions.meaning_en: said to make someone feel better after a mistake
expressions.example: You missed the bus? It happens to the best of us.

grammar.title: Fixed idioms with 'the'
grammar.explanation_ar: كثير من التعابير الثابتة تحتوي the ولا نحذفها: the royal treatment، the plot thickens، the best of us، the rough with the smooth. لكن نقول a change for the better (مع a). لا تغيّر أدوات التعريف في التعابير.
grammar.explanation_en: Many fixed idioms contain 'the', and we don't remove it: the royal treatment, the plot thickens, the best of us. But we say 'a change for the better' with 'a'. Don't change the articles in idioms.
examples: They gave us the royal treatment.
It was a change for the better.

questions.explanation_en: We say 'a change for the better'.
